# Micro Frontend Architect Skill

## Overview
This skill provides guidance on:
- Setting up Module Federation configuration.
- Defining shared dependencies and version negotiation.
- Deploying independent frontends and integrating them into a host shell.
- Managing runtime communication between micro frontends.

## Common Tasks
- Create `webpack.config.js` with `ModuleFederationPlugin`.
- Define exposed components and remote entry points.
- Set up CI pipelines for independent builds.
- Implement version compatibility checks.

## References
- Official Webpack Module Federation documentation.
- Best practices for micro-frontend testing and deployment.
